name: Bitter-eggplant soup
summary: Êđê bitter-eggplant soup, made either with pounded dried fish and rice-washing water or with beef offal and beef bung. Both are bitter from the eggplant and hot from chili, and the offal pot is also sweet and fragrant.
origin: Bao Dak Lak calls canh cà đắng an Êđê specialty of Dak Lak.
howToEat: Eat it with white rice. Culantro, lá é, and scallion go in at the end.
where: Stilt-house meals in Buon Don, Lak, and Buon Ma Thuot.
seoTitle: Canh ca dang — Ede bitter-eggplant soup
seoDescription: Ede bitter-eggplant soup with dried fish or beef offal, bitter, hot, and eaten with white rice.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls the soup harsh-bitter from the eggplant and hot from the chili.
The 24 Jun 2013 article calls the beef-offal version deeply bitter, sweet from the offal, fragrant from the bung, and hot from the chili, with lá é and scallion.
